answer_1.quote: We evaluate model behavior across four widely used bias-assessment task types... The completion task involves free-form continuations of an input sentence. The association task uses short prompts intended to elicit single-word or concept-level responses... the sentence completion task involves fill-in-the-blank prompts targeting gendered term insertions within sentence contexts.

answer_2.quote: We employ two complementary metrics... (1) Token Probability: Measures the model-assigned likelihoods for gendered tokens... (2) Proportion of Choices: Measures the frequency with which gendered pronouns or terms are selected... For proportion-based evaluations... For token probability evaluations, we record the log-probabilities assigned to each candidate pronoun...
